optimiser.controls_coverage_note: VFD = the SPM set-point over the cycle: the twin's declining SPM schedule (start speed = the 'spm' lever, lowered daily to the rods' fall-velocity limit, 2-spm floor) is what a VFD executes; the intra-stroke speed profile is out of scope.
